summary: A change that shows at once on the device (renaming a space, ending or leaving one, blocking someone, removing a friend, a new avatar…) and is refused once it reaches everyone else was quietly undone: only 'pending' writes surfaced the refusal, so a host who renamed a space offline to a name the team had stopped allowing just saw the old name come back. Fixed with SyncEngine.unheardRefusals / useUnheardRefusals and RefusedChangeNotice, which tells each refusal once in a toast that says what was not saved and why, and acknowledges it when the toast leaves.
